caption:
Looking for the best breakfast in Seshadripuram or planning a proper Bengaluru breakfast walk? 👀 We explored 3 iconic old-school South Indian breakfast spots in Seshadripuram serving some of the most comforting dosas, idly-vada combinations, filter coffee and Bengaluru-style sambar you’ll find in the city ❤️

📍Spot 1: Kamat Kala Ruchi (Chitrakala Parishath Canteen)
Simple, classic Bengaluru breakfast done right. Their Idly Vada Sambar Dip is pure comfort food and easily one of the best sambars in Bangalore. Don’t miss the Onion Dose and Masala Dose here.
https://maps.app.goo.gl/xwA5yaqjNsktM8HQ7

📍Spot 2: HVR Veg
Their famous Jodi Masala Dose with white butter is a must-have! And the Masala Idly? So soft it literally melts as you touch it 🤌🏽 One of the most underrated breakfast spots in Bengaluru.
https://maps.app.goo.gl/rQZYm64aACZt3LsR7

📍Spot 3: Janardhana Hotel
Pure old Bengaluru vibes ✨ An OG breakfast spot known for their classic Masala Dose, Sagu Dose and iconic Badam Halwa combo. End it with a strong filter coffee and your breakfast walk is complete ☕️
https://maps.app.goo.gl/3BC27Kca9CtpgKkV7

If you’ve been searching for the best dosa in Seshadripuram, Bangalore breakfast walks, authentic South Indian breakfast in Bengaluru or iconic old-school breakfast spots in Bangalore, save this reel for your next morning food trail 👀

Share this with your Breakfast gang ❤️
